Diagram maintenance

These conceptual maps explain selected core views, with complete Chinese counterparts:

  • Encounter connects YY-05, YY-10, and YY-11: records, candidate models, an adopted view, generated work, and returning evidence within human–model activity. YY-09 supplies its event-based vocabulary.
  • Layers develops YY-09: physical grounding, computational abstraction, and the relations among ontology, epistemology, value, methods, and practice.

The candidate JSON files own the authored labels, relationships, guided views, and explanatory cards. HTML is the standalone interactive viewer. SVG is the viewer's native static export of the graph and legend; the HTML cards and guided views remain available in the viewer.

Regeneration

The current viewers use Archify 3.1.0. From the Yinyang references directory, set ARCHIFY_CLI to the installed bin/archify.mjs and choose a temporary CHECK_DIR for the run:

node "$ARCHIFY_CLI" finalize architecture diagrams/encounter.candidate.json diagrams/encounter.html --quality showcase --out-dir "$CHECK_DIR/encounter" --json
node "$ARCHIFY_CLI" finalize architecture diagrams/layers.candidate.json diagrams/layers.html --quality showcase --out-dir "$CHECK_DIR/layers" --json
node "$ARCHIFY_CLI" finalize architecture diagrams/encounter.zh-CN.candidate.json diagrams/encounter.zh-CN.html --quality showcase --out-dir "$CHECK_DIR/encounter-zh" --json
node "$ARCHIFY_CLI" finalize architecture diagrams/layers.zh-CN.candidate.json diagrams/layers.zh-CN.html --quality showcase --out-dir "$CHECK_DIR/layers-zh" --json

Regenerate only changed candidates or artifacts requiring repair. After successful finalization, use Export → SVG · Auto (or 导出 → SVG · 自动) for the matching static export. Headless browser controls preserve desktop focus. Retain the semantic translation overrides when updating the tool: they describe questions and modeled relationships rather than software services.

Check meaningful labels, directions, and readability against the owning text. Native delivery and browser receipts are execution evidence and contain local paths; keep them with that execution rather than distributing a second hash registry. A future checkout can run its own checks on its actual artifacts.

Trace motion follows authored arrows. It illustrates local relationships, not a mandatory sequence, causal strength, or measured rate of development. Both maps leave activity outside their selected questions unrepresented.

Retain third-party notices with viewers and exports; the original claims keep their own license.
